changes: game/SaveDocumentStorageController.cs adds ALLRPCS_INGREDIENT_REMEDY_CHECK to the isolated smoke-check list, so IngredientRemedyFlowCheck saves to a per-process temp file instead of deleting and overwriting the developer's real user:// save.

game/OpeningRegionRemedyPreparationInputCoordinator.cs: after the cure the station says the remedy was given (RemedyGivenStatusText) instead of that dose changed nothing; once every authored dose is given a press leaves the station unchanged and says so (NoDoseLeftStatusText) instead of resetting it and falling back to the ready text; while the Healer carries the moonwort the idle text says to bring the Healer (HealerCarryingStatusText).

src/Application/Diseases/RemedyStationPolicy.cs: Choose takes whether the Healer carries the herb and whether it is near. A distant Healer carrying the herb now yields WaitForHealer, so a press never turns into the look-alike (which cannot be cancelled and costs one of the two doses) while the herb is carried.

game/HerbExaminationActionController.cs: each gathering refusal ends the status with its own reason (ask the Healer to gather them if they are safe; the moonwort is already gathered; the Healer cannot carry more; already gathered and used). An engine refusal to record the collection or to take the recorded herb is a named GD.PushError. The class summary now covers conditional examinations and gathering.

src/Application/Dialogue/ConditionalCollectionPolicy.cs: a conditional acceptance collects only when its examined target is the result's object; a shortcut comment records that the condition text is not interpreted.

src/Application/Diseases/RemedyPreparationLifecycle.cs: TryStart refuses a gathered herb for any recipe but the remedy (restoration rebuilds no other recipe's herb), and the gathered-duplicate test compares ingredient ids, so a scenario that skipped the structural policy refuses instead of throwing ArgumentException past the InvalidOperationException catch.

src/Domain/Persistence/FirstPatientSaveStateRestorationTransition.cs rejects a restored stabilized patient unless an administration record used the authored remedy recipe; a wrong dose changes nothing, so it cannot explain stabilization.

Inventory restore now agrees with history: RemedyStationPolicy.GatheredHerbIsHeld derives from the saved event log (the herb-patch collection) and the rebound first-patient state (no remedy batch or remedy dose) whether the moonwort is still held; InventoryRestorationPolicy.CanRestore requires exactly the authored starting objects plus the held gathered objects to be carried, so a duplicated or lost herb rejects the load. A save without an inventory (a migrated schema 9 save, or a null v10 section) restores the authored start plus a still-held moonwort in the Healer's hands, so a pre-inventory save whose herb was already collected can still reach the remedy. The rejection message names the saved entries.
game/SaveSnapshotCaptureController.cs returns no capture when the inventory is uninitialized, so a live save always records its inventory.

src/Domain/Persistence/SaveSnapshot.cs: the recovery and continuation exception messages name the inventory schema; the constructor summary and the continuation/inventory comments are current. InventoryOwnershipJsonReader and InventoryRestorationPolicy docs describe the history-derived start; the restoration policy carries a shortcut comment for the day a starting object can be used up.

game/OpeningRegionFirstPatientAdministrationInputCoordinator.cs records a look-alike dose with its own procedure text instead of the remedy-batch procedure, and its comment no longer claims the engine decides what a wrong dose did.
src/Domain/Diseases/FirstPatientScenario.cs: AlternativeRecipes says the structural policy, not the constructor, keeps the remedy out of the alternatives.

scripts/smoke-godot.sh: the IngredientRemedyFlowCheck deadline is 6000 frames (the check caps itself at 60 fps), covering its 60 s Healer wait, 30 s examination wait and three Main launches; the comment says it is the whole launch's budget.

New tests: station choice for every carrier/distance combination and GatheredHerbIsHeld; a gathered herb refused for the look-alike; an unverified scenario refusing instead of throwing; conditional collection of a different target refused; inventory restoration rejecting a duplicated and a lost herb; rebinding a look-alike dose and its batch to one authored preparation, rejecting a stabilized patient whose only dose was the look-alike (fails when the new check is removed), and rejecting a look-alike recipe id on the remedy's inputs; testimony and Sage-consultation restoration after a wrong dose followed by the remedy.

game/IngredientRemedyFlowCheck.cs also proves that a distant Healer's moonwort keeps the station waiting, that the station says the remedy was given after the cure, and that a save and Continue after the cure restore the stabilization, both doses and the used-up moonwort with the station closed. SaveSnapshotRestorationControllerSmokeCheck proves four unfit saved inventories (missing lens, unknown object, unknown owner, an ungathered herb) reject the load and keep a changed live inventory, and that a save without one restores the authored start.
declined: Rejecting a null inventory section in a schema 10 document: in-process check roots and the schema 9 migration share that null, and restoring it now derives a still-held herb from history, so a null no longer loses the herb or soft-locks the remedy.
plan_corrections: Item 6 says IngredientRemedyFlowCheck runs a controlled Ollama fixture; it supplies a scripted in-process ICharacterModel through TemporaryCharacterModelSource.TrySupplyModel.

Item 6 says save, a fresh Main and Continue keep the Healer's moonwort and the Healer then gives at the station; the check gives before saving, so the save records the Seeker carrying the moonwort and after Continue the Seeker only uses it.
Item 4 says P prepares the look-alike unless the Seeker or a nearby Healer carries moonwort; from this fix a distant Healer carrying it makes P wait instead.

Item 5 says schema 9 migrates with no inventory, which restores the authored starting inventory, and that preflight rejects unknown objects, owners and over-capacity inventories; from this fix a missing inventory also restores a moonwort the history still holds, and preflight also rejects an inventory that disagrees with the history.

native.note: The three quarantined launches (#437, #439, #448) also passed this run; quarantine membership is unchanged here.

verification.ingredient_remedy_flow: IngredientRemedyFlowCheck passed with the new distant-Healer, post-cure status and cured save/Continue assertions; it fails with exit 1 when the WaitForHealer arm is removed (the press starts the look-alike).

issues: The first full smoke run failed SaveSnapshotCaptureControllerSmokeCheck (exit 124, 365 passed): the new inventory guard read the inventory node before the existing guards, so a capture controller built without one threw instead of returning no capture. The guard now runs after them, and the rerun below passed.
